page_title: BAY 3-0 MAI | Bayern Munich v Mainz 26/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Corner kick. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is ready to send the ball into the box.

90+3' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.
90+2' The corner is swung in and Armindo Sieb (Mainz) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in.
90+2' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harry Kane leaves the pitch and Jonah Kusi Asare (Bayern Munich) comes on.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Silvan Widmer (Mainz) replaces Paul Nebel.
87' Here is a change. Jae-Sung Lee is going off and Bo Henriksen gives the last tactical orders to Arnaud Nordin (Mainz).
86' That's the end of the game for Jonathan Burkardt, who is replaced by Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
86' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
84' 3 - 0 Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the top right corner. The score is 3:0.
84' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) will take the corner.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leroy Sane departs the field of play to be replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
84' Vincent Kompany decides to make a substitution. Aleksandar Pavlovic will be replaced by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich).
82' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
79' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
76' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Nelson Weiper (Mainz) replaces Phillipp Mwene.
72' Substitution. Serge Gnabry walks off the pitch and Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) comes on as a substitute.
71' Referee Bastian Dankert seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and no action will be taken against Danny da Costa (Mainz).

68' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Danny da Costa (Mainz) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
68' Yellow card. Danny da Costa (Mainz) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
67' The shots on goal statistics – 4:2.

62' OFF THE POST! Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
59' Michael Olise picks out Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich), who drives a shot just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
58' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

57' Danny da Costa (Mainz) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort. It will be a corner kick for Mainz.
57' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

56' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Jonas Urbig, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mainz.
53' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
52' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) commits a foul during an attacking move.
50' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
48' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Bastian Dankert who sees an offensive foul.
46' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' Vincent Kompany has made a change at the break. Sacha Boey has come on in place of Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich).
46' The whistle blows and Bastian Dankert starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) will miss the next game.
45+1' What was Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Robin Zentner is alert and denies him with a nice save. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
44' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
40' 2 - 0 Goal! Konrad Laimer plays a simple square pass into the feet of Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
38' An attempted cross from Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is cleared.
37' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
36' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
35' Rough tackle by Danny da Costa (Mainz). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' The foul by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) was seen by Bastian Dankert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
28' Bo Henriksen is forced to make a change. Anthony Caci is unable to continue due to injury, Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) comes on.
27' 1 - 0 Goal! Konrad Laimer shows great vision to find Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
25' Looks like Anthony Caci (Mainz) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
23' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
21' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
17' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
16' Bastian Dankert blows the whistle, Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) is penalised for a foul.
13' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
12' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

11' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Robin Zentner is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
8' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
6' A lofted pass finds Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar.
5' Bastian Dankert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Eric Dier (Bayern Munich).
4' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Paul Nebel (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Mainz will take the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert is the one to supervise the game today.
